title: Kirby Problem 3.56
exact_target: Determine the possible Seiberg--Witten Floer spectra, compare Floer L-spaces with homotopy L-spaces, find equal-homology manifolds with different spectra, and compute spectra algorithmically, with the ordinary, circle and Pin(2) versions kept distinct.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2854 (KP-3.56). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (editors), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295 (2026), Problem 3.56, p. 171 and following remarks; original author version.
